title: ActionCall
description: One proposed operation. `action` must be an id in the client's published vocabulary and `params` must fill exactly that action's declared parameters — a vendor selects, it cannot invent. Patterns are anchored by the client before matching. `because` is shown next to the consent prompt: an action without a reason a person can evaluate is not a request for consent.

upstream.description: Optional. What the publisher says about the software the change is for. A client keeps it in its record of the change and looks again after updates; it never trusts it as a fact about the machine — the package name is only used to ask the package manager for the installed version.

package.description: The package name as the distribution's package manager knows it.

issue.description: The upstream issue or pull request the change works around.

fixed_in.description: The first version that carries the fix, compared as pacman compares versions.
